title: Hackers backdoor Linux servers using trojanized CWP web server
content_md:
Attackers distribute a malicious updater that replaces CWP's legitimate cwpsrv web-server binary with a trojanized version. The backdoor remains dormant until attackers activate it through specially crafted HTTP requests containing encrypted commands. What makes this particularly dangerous is its stealth. CWPdoor suppresses logging of malicious requests, restores file timestamps, deletes evidence of installation, and encrypts communications to make detection more difficult. Researchers identified evidence suggesting real-world infections, although the number of compromised servers remains unknown.
